intent: Standalone visual exploration, not a website implementation or deployment
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single, beautifully designed complete ICON CONTACT SHEET for Toli.me. This is an illustration asset catalogue for review, not a web page or a map.
Create exactly 54 distinct labeled icons, in a precise grid of SIX COLUMNS by NINE ROWS. Portrait canvas, target 2048 x 3072, large enough for clear short labels. Show the full sheet with generous outer margins and no clipped items. Small elegant header at top: "Toli’s little worlds". Subtitle: "54 icons · one curious human". No other header/footer copy.
Reference image 1: character identity reference ONLY for recognizable Pickle Rick, the green walking storybook, red apple in code braces, and creatures in an Easter egg. Reference image 2: identity reference ONLY for Dota Invoker with purple/gold robe and three colored spell orbs, heart lantern, energy cords, glasses, repaired heart and hourglass.
NEW execution: clean collectible sticker / editorial icon style, flatter and more graphic than the references. Consistent bold dark-forest contour, simple rounded shapes, restrained 3-color shading per icon, bright controlled jewel/pastel colors, subtle handmade line personality. Warm almost-solid ivory background. Each icon floats independently on the same page, no enclosing cards, no roads, no paths, no scenery, no grass, no buildings, no city, no map, no decorative fillers. No white sticker borders or drop shadows. Let the object be the icon. Characters may have expressive faces when specified. Actual recognizable symbols, not generic badges. All human figures are adults, fully clothed, and nonsexual.
Each grid cell has ONE icon and beneath it a crisp centered dark-forest sans-serif short caption, including its two-digit catalogue number. Long captions can wrap into two compact lines. All icons have similar visual weight and generous blank space. No repeated captions or extra icons. Do not combine cells or omit items. Tiny gold star next to captions 03, 05, 15, 19 marks featured projects. Keep every other caption unadorned.
